plan.name: string-storage

rust_handoff.kind: frozen String canonical and four matched Rust diagnostics; no new performance observations
rust_handoff.validation_contract: fresh Node process, exact original stdin, exit0, exact expected Result line and one finite nonnegative CSV duration with exact rust-wasm case; reject INCORRECT/panic/trap/timeout; no shortened counts or altered stack flags. Parent owns CPU pinning/order and clean window; process wall time is separate from workload time.
rust_handoff.timer_reference: original common.scm evaluates ok? before t1/j1; Rust final equality precedes report/start.elapsed. WASI monotonic clock backs Instant; Result/CSV formatting follows captured clock.
rust_handoff.node_environment: no custom benchmark flags/env; host inherits env and preopens case cwd as /, WASI preview1

cases.name: string
cases.setup_excluded: Original Scheme-format datum reading and count/threshold parsing, Wasm compile/instantiate/startup. Fixed ASCII seed is allocated anew inside every trial.
cases.predicate_boundary: All 100 iterations, ten full trials per iteration, all growth/copy/rotation/allocation/drop work and final length equality. Rust result/CSV formatting follows start.elapsed().

correctness.predicate: Full run returns final string byte length 524278, then equals supplied expected datum before timer ends. Original canonical alphabet is ASCII, so byte length equals Scheme character length.
correctness.small: actual Node/Wasm and unchanged Chez count2/threshold30/result54 pass, wrong999 rejected by both
correctness.complete_payload: native grow(abcdef) equals 56abcdef789123abcdef45; this is not an actual-Wasm complete payload dump

cases.timed: All 100 iterations, ten full trials per iteration, all growth/copy/rotation/allocation/drop work and final length equality. Rust result/CSV formatting follows start.elapsed().
cases.representation: Rust UTF-8 String storage, byte slicing and byte length; grow first format!(123{s}456{s}789), then materializes both owned overlapping substrings, then appends front to the owned back buffer. ASCII seed/literals stay ASCII. Scheme uses Unicode-character strings and fresh string-append results.
cases.ownership: Rust keeps the prior local string borrowed through grow and releases it after replacing s; substring/format buffers are owned and promptly dropped. Final trial strings are promptly dropped after the black_box/length read. Scheme mutates persistent global s, retaining its last trial string until next reset and leaving reclamation to GC. Rust append may reuse/reallocate the back buffer.
cases.opacity: black_box(n) for each outer call; black_box(run(...)) for each returned length; black_box(trial(n)) exposes each complete String pointer/length/capacity before reading length. No additional complete-payload comparison is added inside timing.
cases.source_semantics: Count, threshold and expected value must fit nonnegative Wasm32 usize. Only the fixed ASCII seed is supported; this is not a general Unicode substring routine or unbounded Scheme numeric domain. Zero/negative iteration and threshold domains differ from the original harness outside checked fixtures.

inspection.notes: Exact frozen optimized Wasm retains formatted byte copies, both distinct owned overlapping substrings and final append/reallocation, ten full trials and supplied outer count. String pointer/length/capacity spill precedes length sampling; no payload-equivalence validation is inside timing. The threshold<6 path has unrolled seed-only trials and is outside canonical threshold500000.

cases.name: string-byte-four-buffer
cases.setup_excluded: CLI and original datum decoding/count+threshold parsing precede Instant. Trial seed allocation occurs inside the timer.
cases.predicate_boundary: Original final scalar equality (including expected.number conversion) precedes report/start.elapsed; no complete payload validation is inside the timer.

correctness.predicate: Last invocation returns last trial element length524278 and equals supplied expected datum.
correctness.complete_audits: Six small thresholds and one additional full500000 trial after timing agree completely with the original Chez grow/trial oracle; these are not the last timed trial output.
correctness.negative: All four reject expected999; complete audit comparator rejects interior corruption preserving length and missing entries.

cases.timed: Full100 invocations, each ten reset trials, all15 grows/trial, four fresh buffers/grow, source-order copies and ownership releases, existing input/trial/result black_box boundaries and final scalar predicate.
cases.representation: Vec<u8> ASCII byte elements; exact requested element capacities and four distinct owned buffers; standard Vec copy/append primitives with a fresh final destination, rather than formatting or back-buffer append reuse.
cases.ownership: Old vector is freed after the first concat completes. First/suffix/prefix remain alive until fresh final construction then are freed together. Completed trial crosses black_box, length is read, then final vector is dropped before next trial. Both widths match this schedule; frozen String keeps old borrowed longer and may reuse/reallocate the back buffer.
cases.opacity: Same black_box on threshold per invocation, complete final trial Vec before length, and invocation result. No additional per-buffer opacity or full-result validation inside timer.
cases.initialization: Capacity allocation and complete append copies; no requested payload zero initialization. Four allocations and both owned substring copies survive optimized Wasm.
cases.source_semantics: Fixed ASCII seed/literals, element-index slicing and original middle overlap. Successful supported inputs fit nonnegative Wasm32 usize/resource limits; count0 numeric0 differs from original Scheme #f, negative counts/thresholds and general Unicode string inputs are outside this control domain.

retained_work.evidence: Each specialized trial has one seed and four loop allocation sites, six dynamic full memory.copy sites plus literal stores, no back-buffer reuse. Separate counter diagnostic verifies1,000 seeds+60,000 grow allocations.

cases.peak_note: Excludes allocator rounding/headers, retained free blocks, input/audit/runtime storage; distinct from linear-memory capacity and physical RSS.
